text:
laura: FYI — seeing 5xx spike from eu-region (api-gateway). Putting a hold on any releases targeting eu for the next 60m.
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Release hold placed by laura on release_id=rls-2026-03-15-42 slot=19 targets=[eu-west-1] reason=incident-eu-503s ttl=60m
tyler: ack. which slots are affected? I have a canary running in eu but can pivot to us-west if we need to keep velocity.
maria: can we pin the control-plane version for repro? last change was cp v2.14.1 — worried about config drift during reshuffle.
ops-lead: +1 on pinning. ops preference: defer slot 19 to next available eu maintenance window and move the canary to us-west for now.
sre-oncall: investigating gateway errors; initial hypothesis is rate-limiter misconfig after config rollout. ETA 25m for root cause.
laura: plan: 1) hold all eu rollouts (deploy-bot already). 2) pin control-plane to v2.14.1 for any retry jobs. 3) if canary needs to keep running, retarget to us-west and mark as non-prod. 4) Ops to requeue slot 19 into 02:00-04:00 UTC window if still degraded after 60m.
tyler: I can repoint canary. moving traffic to us-west now — will post confirmation.
maria: adding note to release notes: "deferred eu rollout due to transient gateway errors; will requeue when eu stability confirmed" — will also tag changelog with pinned cp version.
ops-lead: requeue command to use when ready: ```/deploybot requeue --release rls-2026-03-15-42 --slot 19 --window 02:00-04:00 UTC --reason "post-incident requeue"```
sre-oncall: update: discovered mis-applied throttle rule on api-gateway. Rolling back that config now, monitoring 10m. If healthy, we can lift hold early.
deploy-bot: Note: manual override required to lift hold. Use: ```/deploybot resume --release rls-2026-03-15-42 --by <user> --notes "incident mitigated"```
laura: ok please wait for SRE sign-off before resuming. @sre-oncall tag when green.
sre-oncall: green at 1719002700 — 503 rate down to baseline. Recommend lifting hold and requeue per ops plan.
laura: thanks. @ops-lead please requeue when ops sweep confirms staging smoke tests pass.
ops-lead: will run smoke tests, then requeue. timeline ~15m.
tyler: canary repoint complete — traffic shifted to us-west and dashboards look stable. :thumbsup:
maria: queued release note entry and added changelog line about cp pin.
laura: thanks everyone. leaving this thread open until release rescheduled.
